sites.name: AutoTempest
sites.notes: One search across CL, CarGurus, Autotrader, etc. Start here daily.

sites.name: Autotrader
sites.notes: My Autotrader — saved searches & email alerts (free account). Strong truck filters.

sites.name: CarGurus
sites.notes: Deal rating vs market. Save search + subscribe for new listings under $20k.

sites.name: Cars.com
sites.notes: Similar inventory to Autotrader; cross-check price on same VIN.

sites.name: Autolist
sites.notes: Pulls many dealer feeds; price-drop alerts on saved listings.

sites.name: TrueCar
sites.notes: Market pricing context; good for verifying if ask is high/low.

sites.name: Edmunds
sites.notes: Edmunds Insider — inventory email alerts by ZIP/filter (free).

sites.name: iSeeCars
sites.notes: Email alerts for new matches + price drops; can save without account on some flows.

sites.name: Carfax Used Car Listings
sites.notes: One-owner / service-history filters; login to save.

sites.name: Craigslist
sites.notes: Also cosprings, pueblo. Best private/fleet ugly trucks.

sites.name: Facebook Marketplace
sites.notes: Filter Owner · price max $20k · 200 mi from Gardner.

sites.name: OfferUp
sites.notes: Also in Skout kate-vehicles.

sites.name: PrivateAuto
sites.notes: ID-verified private sales; browse open, buy/sell needs account.

sites.name: eBay Motors
sites.notes: Saved search alerts; Duramax HD + square-body / C10 vintage.

sites.name: Cars & Bids
sites.notes: Enthusiast auctions — C10 / square-body / cool specials.

sites.name: ClassicCars.com
sites.notes: Vintage boxy trucks · C10/C20/K20.

sites.name: Hemmings
sites.notes: Classic / square-body classifieds.

sites.name: CumminsForum Classifieds
sites.notes: Ram 2500/3500 diesel; rebuilt trans common in ads.

sites.name: PowerStroke.org Classifieds
sites.notes: 7.3 / 6.7 owner-maintained trucks.

sites.name: Diesel Place — GM Trucks
sites.notes: Duramax 2500HD/3500HD.

sites.name: SilveradoSierra.com Classifieds
sites.notes: GM gas work trucks and rebuilds.

sites.name: GovDeals / AllSurplus
sites.notes: Fleet/municipal surplus trucks — CO+FL state filters. Also scraped into Auto Skout feed.

sites.name: Public Surplus
sites.notes: State/county surplus vehicles. Scraped into feed when Playwright available.

sites.name: PropertyRoom
sites.notes: Police/seized property auctions — trucks under $20k.

sites.name: GSA Fleet Vehicle Sales
sites.notes: Retired federal fleet — often work trucks; verify tow rating + hitch.

sites.name: GovPlanet
sites.notes: Commercial/medium-duty — box trucks, flatbeds; shipping cost matters.
